note: INCONCLUSIVE by the preregistered rule (2 < z <= 3): the layer-3 abundance law with stellar-model lifetimes predicts more horizontal-branch stars than observed, at 2.05 sigma with the primary helium input; with the SBBN helium value (sensitivity only) z = 1.25.
